answer: Every entry must show Anvilbound apprentice whitesmith copper seal before the ledger opens, because a seal apprentice whitesmiths renew after forge trials. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Each attempt carries an examination charge of £68, charged again each time a name fails, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The clerk notes vine. The river is checked, not assumed. Every kernel is counted once.
